qa_pairs.instruction: What default attribute support does the Bidirect eDirectory driver provide out of the box?
qa_pairs.output: The Bidirect eDirectory driver’s default filter for the basic driver configuration supports the set of attributes listed on the Default Attributes page of the documentation.

qa_pairs.instruction: How can you extend the attribute filter to support additional attributes in the Bidirect eDirectory driver?
qa_pairs.output: To extend the attribute filter in the Bidirect eDirectory driver, you edit the driver’s configuration filter definition and add the names of the additional attributes you want to synchronize. After saving the changes, the driver will include those attributes in its synchronization process.

qa_pairs.instruction: Which documentation links are provided for the default attributes and home directory creation for the Bidirect eDirectory driver?
Summarize the key points of the Synchronized Attributes section for the Bidirect eDirectory driver.
qa_pairs.output: The Synchronized Attributes section for the Bidirect eDirectory driver states that the basic driver configuration’s filter includes a predefined set of attributes (see the Default Attributes link) and that you can customize this filter to add more attributes. It also provides a link to documentation on creating home directories for synchronized accounts.
